_comment: AL-UX-PDF-01 · APITemplate.io Settings tab. Enter these in the template's Settings UI; header/footer HTML below is self-contained (inline styles — external CSS does not reach header/footer in chromium print).
footer_html:
Page of  ·  Continue the journey → authorslab.ai/pricing
© 2026 AuthorsLab · a Spike Island Studios company · authorslab.ai  ·  {{manuscriptId}}
_notes: Header appears on every page including the cover if APITemplate has no first-page suppression. Check the template Settings for a 'skip header on first page' option; if absent, this header is quiet enough (8pt, muted) that the cover survives it — accepted fallback per AL-UX-PDF-chrome-v1 §4.
pageNumber/totalPages spans are the chromium print convention APITemplate uses. If the preview shows them empty, swap for APITemplate's documented page-number placeholders.
Footer 'Continue the journey' line is the FREE-variant conversion layer (MKT-010 §2a). Member-variant templates use the same footer WITHOUT that line — see AL-UX-PDF-chrome-v1 §3.
Back page counts in page N of M — deliberate (MKT-010 §5).
